name: Solstice Anchor Chain
core_rationale: Northernmost celestial anchor pier of The Zenith Crown at [1, 0] where Vesper's highest white-gold chain moors the Shattered Halo against the upper stratosphere.

South.lock_message: Zero-gravity star-shear along the Solstice Anchor Chain repels uncalibrated gliders; the Beacon Wardens require the Nave Aurora-Key before opening the northern anchor pier.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Beacon Wardens claim that standing at the tip of the Solstice Anchor lets you hear the lullaby of all three Primordial Gods echoing across the stars.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Avertical chain of colossal white-gold links vanishing upward into a crown of diamond starlight.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What celestial observatory or fourth continent lies moored at the far end of the Solstice Anchor Chain?

causal_continuity.evidence: Forms the northernmost celestial mooring pier of The Zenith Crown above Crown Beacon Citadel.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: A colossal white-gold chain rising into diamond starlight at the apex of the Shattered Halo.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: chain-link catwalk and guardrail metrics for 1.05m characters will be verified upon promotion to Draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: reserved at [1, 0] north of Crown Beacon Citadel behind a fog_of_lore portal.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Maintains map_id: null, fog_of_lore portal symmetry with town-crown-beacon-citadel, and complete mystery_hook.
